description: This file defines the class 'FileExtensionEscapingStrategy' within the Twig namespace. The class provides a static method to determine the autoescaping strategy based on the template filename extension, defaulting to HTML but adjusting for specific file types like JavaScript, JSON, CSS, or disabling escaping for text files.

classes.name: FileExtensionEscapingStrategy
classes.description: Provides a method to guess the best autoescaping strategy based on file name extension.

methods.name: guess
methods.description: Guesses the autoescaping strategy based on the provided template filename.
